sequences.name: Spectator
abilities: Enhanced Mental Attributes: Great enhancements to inferential, analytical, observational, and identification abilities along with memory.
Enhanced Vision: Sharpened eyesight needed to analyze a target's body language.
Body Language Analysis: Keen powers of observation to discover true thoughts from expressions, manners, and subconscious actions.

sequences.name: Telepathist
abilities: Enhanced Vision: Further enhanced eyesight.
Mind Reading: Can read the superficial thoughts of others and simulate the trajectory of such thoughts.
Body Language Analysis: Observation extends to aura, Ether Body, and other mysterious domains.

sequences.name: Psychiatrist (Psyche Analyst)
abilities: Physical Enhancement: Slight increase in physical attributes, strength, speed, and health.
Frenzy: Can trigger emotions and mental state, throwing the target into a frenzy and causing psychological damage.
Telepathy: Can communicate with the Body of Heart and Mind through mediums.
Psychological Cue: Can cue a target to abide by arrangements without realizing it.
Awe (Dragon's Might, Mass Chaos): Can cause targets to panic, freeze, and turn chaotic.
Placate (Psychoanalysis): Can help Beyonders on the brink of losing control regain reason.

sequences.name: Hypnotist
abilities: Physical Enhancement: Strength and agility exceeding ordinary people.
Dragon Scales: Can form a layer of Dragon Scales over skin to resist physical damage.
Psychological Invisibility: Can remain in the blind spot of consciousness, avoiding perception.
Hypnosis: Can directly alter target's consciousness and subconscious.
Battle Hypnotism: Can forcefully hypnotize enemies to do abnormal actions.

sequences.name: Dreamwalker
abilities: Alteration: Can modify target's Dreams, influencing them over a long period.
Guidance: Can guide targets to reveal deepest secrets through Dreams.
Dream Traversal: Can hide in someone else's dream and jump from one dream to another.
Placate (Psychoanalysis): Can treat Demigods that have used their Incomplete Mythical Creature Form.

sequences.name: Manipulator
abilities: Physical Enhancement: Extraordinary strength and exaggerated dragon scale defenses.
Manipulation: Can enter another person's Mind Island to change subconscious and read thoughts.
Mental Plague: Can implant seeds of Mental Plague in the target's Mind Island.
Mind Storm: Can transform thoughts into a Mind Storm causing negative effects.
Virtual Persona: Can create up to 13 Virtual Personas with corresponding Body of Heart and Mind.
Mind Dragon Breath: Breath attack that stimulates the Body of Heart and Mind and Soul Body.
Mind Deprivation: Enhanced Awe causing abnormal conditions in all creatures within range.
Consciousness Stroll: Enhanced Dream Traversal allowing consciousness and Spirit Body to swim in the Sea of Collective Subconscious.

sequences.name: Dream Weaver
abilities: Dream Weaving: Can weave Dreams indistinguishable from reality.
Plague Storm: Can release a storm of thoughts, desires, and wills causing Corruption.
Enhanced Mental Attributes: Control over psyche makes enemy intuition unable to form pictures.
Psychological Invisibility: Can create mental mirages to mask existence.
Consciousness Stroll: Can let physical body enter the Sea of Collective Subconscious.
Virtual Persona: Can separate fake personalities and turn them into living people.

sequences.name: Discerner
abilities: Dream Maze: Can create a Dream Maze made up of Mind Islands of many people.
Discernment: Can discern hidden psychological vulnerabilities and perceive past Fate.
Psychological Cue: Elevated to authority level based on belief.
Dream Weaving: Can weave images into reality, creating flawless illusions.
Consciousness Stroll: Deeper perception of the Sea of Collective Subconscious.
Virtual Persona: Can elevate a target's Mind Island, suppressing consciousness.

sequences.name: Author (Fairy Tale Author)
abilities: Dream of Reality: Can intertwine Dreams with reality, allowing illusion and substance to coexist.
Coincidence: Can turn accidental phenomena into echoes of the mind.
Envisioning (Fantasy into Reality): Can temporarily pull concepts into reality.
Discernment: Preliminary control over the Sea of Collective Subconscious; any mention of them will be known.
Psyche (Mind): Partial authority over the Mind; can control Minds of living creatures.

sequences.name: Visionary
abilities: Envisioning (Fantasy into Reality): Can envision materialization of Divine Kingdom and futures.
Psyche (Mind): Master of the Mind World; can regress a being's mind and strip memories.
Humanity: Can artificially manufacture humanity.
Discernment: Omniscient within the Mind World; can extend into Fate, Reality, and Illusion Domains.
Dream: Partial Dream authority.
Loss of Control: Partial authority over Loss of Control.
